features.reviewNotes: Imported from the HES national Listed Buildings spatial data. Statutory listing and location are authoritative; construction-date review remains separate. NRHE record linked by matching point location; review if it represents a distinct asset.
features.fullDescription: Early 18th century or perhaps 17th century walled garden and doocot. Old coped garden wall north and west sides. Circular doocot at southwest corner, rubble-built with pinnings and conical roof. Two table sundials. Sundial within garden by Adam Charles in 1846 and has a metal dial on baluster. Sundial to south of garden is a stone, octagonal table dating around 1850.
